name: Abdalmalik of Morocco
contribution: Sultan of Morocco from March 1728 to March 1729 and a member of the Alaouite dynasty.

checks.lead: Sultan Moulay Abdelmalik (Arabic: عبد الملك بن إسماعيل العلوي) (1675 – 2 March 1729) was Sultan of Morocco from March 1728 to March 1729 and a member of the Alaouite dynasty.
